description: This file defines the routing configuration for a Flutter application. It includes the setup of a router with route parsing logic, a custom RouterDelegate, and the initial page set to AuthGate.

classes.name: _AppRoutePath
classes.description: Represents a route's path with a location string.

classes.name: _AppRouteInformationParser
classes.description: Parses route information into _AppRoutePath objects and vice versa.

classes.name: _AppRouterDelegate
classes.description: Handles building the Navigator widget and managing route configuration.

methods.name: buildRouter
methods.description: Builds and returns the RouterConfig with delegate and parser.
